title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·       Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·       5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·       Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·       Brazil-based (fully remote )

·       Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·       Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·       Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·       Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·       High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·       Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph  describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um projeto global do nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do setor de óleo e gás , assumindo um papel técnico-estratégico dedicado ao Azure DevOps (ADO) e às plataformas de dados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Trabalhar com estruturas de dados de média a alta complexidade em ambiente corporativo.
  • Atuar de forma hands-on com SQL para manipulação e análise de dados.
  • Transformar dados utilizando Azure Data Factory (ADF), incluindo criação e otimização de pipelines.
  • Implementar lógica e análises utilizando DAX.
  • Modelar dados (normalização, desnormalização e star schema).
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos DBT, incluindo criação de testes de dados.
  • Atuar com soluções em Azure para armazenamento, integração e processamento de dados.
  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes Azure DevOps: acessos, permissões, configurações de projeto, repositórios e integrações.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders internos e externos para avaliar automações, integrações e fluxos customizados dentro do Azure DevOps.
  • Oferecer direcionamento técnico sobre uso avançado da plataforma Azure DevOps, incluindo escalabilidade e integrações com GitHub, ServiceNow e serviços Azure.
  • Criar e manter automações utilizando Power Platform (principalmente Power Automate).
  • Comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos técnicos e não técnicos em inglês.


O que você precisa ter

  • Forte experiência em administração de Azure DevOps (ADO) e pipelines.
  • Experiência sólida com Power Platform, principalmente Power Automate.
  • SQL avançado (mandatório).
  • Experiência com ADF, Data Pipelines e orquestração de dados.
  • Conhecimento em DBT e DAX.
  • Conhecimentos de Azure Infrastructure.
  • Experiência em liderança técnica.
  • Perfil com forte senso de ownership e visão de dono da solução.
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório)



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

Experiência com Python ou PowerQuery/Power BI.

Certificações relevantes:

  • DP-203 – Azure Data Engineer Associate
  • PL-500 – Power Platform Developer Associate

Experiência em ambientes corporativos com estruturas de dados complexas.

Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e atenção a detalhes.

title: Android Developer (Java) (Req. English)
description:
Fetchly Labs is a forward-thinking technology company specializing in innovative mobile solutions. We work on cutting-edge projects that emphasize user-centric design, scalability, and seamless performance. Join our fully remote team and contribute to developing high-quality Android applications using Java, while collaborating in an agile environment.
Position Overview We are seeking a skilled Android Developer to join our team. You'll build and maintain scalable mobile applications using modern Android development technologies, with a strong emphasis on test-driven development and API integration.
Key Responsibilities
  • Develop native Android applications using Java and modern Android frameworks
  • Design and implement robust mobile architectures following best practices
  • Practice test-driven development for reliable and maintainable code
  • Integrate with RESTful APIs and backend services
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and participate in code reviews
  • Optimize application performance and ensure smooth user experiences
Required Technical Skills Android Development
  • Java for Android (required) - native Android app development using Java with Android SDK
  • Kotlin (preferred) - modern Android development language
  • Android Runtime (ART) and Android SDK fundamentals
  • Android Studio IDE proficiency
  • Android Jetpack components (ViewModel, LiveData, Room, Navigation)
  • Material Design guidelines and UI/UX principles
  • Responsive layouts and multi-device support
  • Java/Kotlin interoperability in mixed codebases
Architecture & Patterns
  • MVVM, MVP, or Clean Architecture
  • Dependency injection (Dagger, Hilt)
  • Reactive programming (RxJava, Coroutines, Flow)
  • Repository pattern and data layer design
Backend Integration
  • RESTful API consumption (Retrofit, OkHttp)
  • JSON parsing and data serialization
  • Authentication and authorization implementation
  • GraphQL (nice to have)
Testing & DevOps
  • Test-driven development methodology
  • Testing frameworks: JUnit, Espresso, Mockito, Robolectric
  • Unit, integration, and UI testing
  • CI/CD pipeline setup (GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Jenkins)
  • Version control with Git
Data & Storage
  • SQLite and Room database
  • SharedPreferences and DataStore
  • Local caching strategies
  • Firebase integration (Firestore, Realtime Database)
Nice to Have
  • React Native experience for cross-platform development
  • Flutter knowledge
  • Jetpack Compose for modern UI development
  • Firebase services (Analytics, Crashlytics, Cloud Messaging)
  • In-app purchases and subscription management
  • Google Play Store publishing and release management
  • Push notifications implementation
  • Deep linking and app navigation
  • Performance profiling and optimization tools
Preferred Qualifications
  • 3+ years of professional Android development experience
  • Published apps on Google Play Store
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills
  • Understanding of mobile app security best practices
  • Experience with offline-first architecture

title: ADP Tester
description:
ADP Tester – Workday to ADP Payroll Transformation

Title: ADP Tester (5–7 Years)

Location: Brazil 100% Remote

Type: Contract

Client: Kyndryl

Overview

We are seeking an experienced ADP Tester to support a large-scale Workday-to-ADP payroll transformation program. The consultant will be responsible for validating end-to-end payroll processing across Workday and ADP (GlobalView / Workforce Now / Celergo), ensuring data accuracy, compliance with payroll rules, and a smooth transition to the new payroll landscape. This role requires strong hands-on experience testing ADP payroll solutions, deep understanding of gross-to-net calculations, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in HR, Payroll, and IT.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, design, and execute test cases for Workday-to-ADP payroll integrations, including end-to-end payroll cycles.
  • Validate payroll processing results, including earnings, deductions, taxes, and gross-to-net calculations across ADP platforms.
  • Review and validate data mapping and transformations between Workday and ADP (GlobalView, Workforce Now, or Celergo).
  • Test inbound and outbound interface files between Workday and ADP, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to defined formats.
  • Execute functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) for payroll-related processes.
  • Log, track, and document defects using the client’s defect management tools, working with technical and functional teams to drive timely resolution.
  • Support parallel payroll testing cycles by comparing legacy and new payroll results, identifying and analyzing variances.
  • Collaborate closely with Workday configuration teams, ADP SMEs, payroll operations, and project managers to clarify requirements, test scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
  • Develop and maintain test documentation, including test plans, scripts, scenarios, and status reports.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, standards, and templates for payroll transformation projects.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5–7 years of hands-on experience testing ADP payroll solutions.
  • Practical experience with one or more of the following: ADP GlobalView, ADP Celergo, and/or ADP Workforce Now.
  • Strong knowledge of payroll rules, calculations, and end-to-end gross-to-net processing (earnings, deductions, benefits, taxes).
  • Experience testing payroll integrations, including validation of inbound and outbound interface files.
  • Ability to design and execute test cases, analyze results, and document defects in a structured way.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, global environments with HR, Payroll, and IT stakeholders.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Nice to Have / Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of Workday payroll configuration and Workday payroll interface (WPI) or similar Workday outbound interfaces.
  • Experience with large-scale payroll transformation or migration projects.
  • Prior experience working with global payroll across multiple countries and legal entities.
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and working within structured project frameworks.

Engagement Details

This is a contract position supporting Kyndryl on a Workday-to-ADP payroll transformation initiative. Candidates may be based in the US, Brazil, or India and must be comfortable collaborating with distributed, multicultural teams located in multiple time zones.

description:
Senior Frontend UX Engineer

Location: Brazil, Mexico (Remote)

Pluto TV is looking for an experienced Senior Frontend UX Engineer for the development of new as well as enhancement of existing applications. Applications include Command Center and related MFEs, plus other applications owned by our sister teams including Content Systems, Media Asset Management System (MAM), Content Management System (CMS), Content Feeds Services (CFEEDS), and Revenue. Candidates must have hands-on experience with Javascript, React, CSS Components Design and similar JavaScript-based technologies, strong experience working in highly technical teams, and proven experience building solutions with AWS services such as S3, Lambda, ECS, and more.

The company, which was set up in 1981 to help the nascent IT industry overcome its human resource challenges, today ranks among the world’s leading training companies owing to its vast, yet comprehensive array of talent development programs. With a footprint across 40 nations, NIIT offers training and development solutions to Individuals, Enterprises, and Institutions.

Link to our website -

Position: Training Coordinator


We are looking for our next training operations coordinator. This role is part of the Operations team and supports NIIT’s customer(s) in Frankfurt.

to deliver outstanding service.

We all work together on a common project with part of the team based in India.

As a training operations coordinator, you will be reporting to the training operations manager.

You will be the key contact point for all local stakeholders, coordinating training session delivery. You will master and oversee all activities within the service.

You will work closely and in partnership with the customer’s learning delivery team.


Roles & Responsibility:


  • Analyze the training needs provided by the Client and determine the number of sessions needed to train the overall number of trainees according to courses and per site,
  • Initiate and manage requests for session creation, modification, completion, and cancellation where required,
  • Organize the training sessions according to trainees’ expectations and availability and ensure their proper execution,
  • Calibrate and coordinate with the Indian team for any changes/updates in the training event/program,
  • Support completion of training activities by following up for attendance and invoice if required,
  • Follow and ensure adherence to the workflow and processes using the CRM tool
  • Ensure Learner Support Level 2

  • Exposure to an international work environment
  • High-level understanding of the training landscape
  • Customer service-oriented posture is a must
  • Team player
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concise thoughts
  • Attention to detail, structured and organized, capable of prioritizing activities
  • Knowledge of Salesforce or any other CRM

  • Proficient in MS Office, Excel, SharePoint

description:

Disponibilidade para trabalhar com escala em fins de semana e feriados;

Ter CNPJ (vaga PJ);

Ter notebook e microfone em casa;

  • Fixo de R$ 2.000 (negociável) + Percentual variável de acordo com a meta sobre todas as vendas + Bônus de até R$900 por metas batidas. Oportunidade de crescimento na liderança de equipe.

title: Senior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Step into the world of advanced software engineering as our Senior Python Developer, where you'll architect sophisticated solutions for global clients. This isn't just about coding, it's about leading technical initiatives, mentoring rising talent, and solving complex challenges using Python's powerful ecosystem while driving innovation in cloud environments, data processing, and web development.

title: Analista de segurança
description:
Required Skills and Experience:

The ideal candidate will bring foundational experience in security operations with a demonstrated ability to investigate and respond to security events. A strong focus on Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is essential, including the ability to analyze data movement, enforce classification standards, and coordinate remediation efforts. Candidates should be comfortable working in dynamic environments, applying core SOC concepts while developing deeper expertise in protecting sensitive data.


  • Experience in cybersecurity or information technology within a SOC or incident response role.
  • Hands-on experience working with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) technologies and processes.
  • Familiarity with common data classification categories (e.g., PII, PCI, PHI) and their security and compliance implications.
  • Experience using Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems for monitoring, triage, and analysis.
  • Exposure to endpoint protection solutions, including antivirus, EDR, or other detection and response technologies.
  • Experience triaging security incidents in cloud-native and SaaS environments .
  • Working knowledge of TCP/IP protocols and OSI Layers 1–4.
  • Ability to analyze event logs and alerts, correlate them with DLP activity, and determine the appropriate remediation.
  • Basic knowledge of adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), Cyber Kill Chain, and MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills for documenting incidents and working with stakeholders during investigations.
  • Ability to maintain integrity, professionalism, and discretion when handling sensitive data.
  • Highly organized, efficient, and capable of managing multiple incidents or tasks with minimal supervision.


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience tuning or refining DLP policies and rules to improve accuracy and reduce false positives.
  • Familiarity with cloud security controls and data governance concepts (e.g., encryption, access control, retention).
  • Exposure to cybersecurity threat hunting techniques and proactive analysis methods.
  • Basic scripting or automation knowledge (e.g., Python, PowerShell, or similar) to support repetitive triage tasks.


Education/Certifications/Training Required:

  • Basic industry certification, such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, or GIAC.
  • Associates' or Bachelors’ Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Security Assurance, or equivalent experience.

title: Representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
Descrição da Empresa: Clínica de nutrição de alta performance, nossa missão é transformar a vida de 30mil mulheres até 2030! Promovemos mudança de vida e tranformação.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos à procura de um Representante de Desenvolvimento de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe vendas, SDR Presencial. As principais atividades diárias incluem identificar e prospectar novos leads, qualificar potenciais clientes, estabelecer e manter relacionamentos comerciais e colaborar com a equipe de vendas para alcançar as metas estabelecidas. É esperado que o profissional contribua ativamente para o desenvolvimento de novas oportunidades de negócios. Jornada de trabalho de 8:00 da manhã as 17 horas.

Qualificações

  • Vendas Internas e Geração de Leads: Experiência comprovada em vendas internas e habilidades para identificar e gerar novos leads de qualidade.
  • Comunicação: Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e persuasiva, tanto verbalmente quanto por escrito, para engajar potenciais clientes e colaborar eficazmente com a equipe.
  • Desenvolvimento de Negócios: Competência para identificar oportunidades de mercado, propor estratégias de crescimento e colaborar com o alcance de metas comerciais.
  • Experiência prévia na área comercial ou em funções correlatas será considerada um diferencial, bem como conhecimentos em ferramentas de gestão de relacionamento com o cliente (CRM).
  • Sobre o Papel:
  • Você será o primeiro contato estratégico com nossos potenciais clientes. Seu papel será identificar, qualificar e nutrir leads através de uma comunicação assertiva, acolhedora e organizada, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento da nossa base de pacientes e dos nossos programas nutricionais.
  • Responsabilidades:
  • Realizar prospecção ativa e qualificação de leads (via Instagram, WhatsApp, Trello, e-mail e CRM).
  • Reativar pacientes e contatos antigos com abordagem humanizada.
  • Encaminhar leads qualificados para as videochamadas de diagnóstico e fechamento.
  • Realizar pesquisas sobre o perfil do lead, analisar dados e organizar as informações na plataforma CRM.
  • Atualizar diariamente o sistema de tarefas.
  • Conduzir parte do processo diretamente pelo Instagram com foco em engajamento.
  • Apresentar relatórios semanais de produtividade ao CEO.
  • Participar de reuniões semanais 1:1 e check-ins estratégicos com o time.


CICLO DE COMUNICAÇÃO DIARIAMENTE: Comunicações sobre itens prioritários via Whatsapp. Comunicações com outros gerentes e membros da equipe sobre itens curtos ou prioritários via Grupo da empresa no WhatsApp. Todas as solicitações/responsabilidades/projetos são adicionados ao trello e atualizados diariamente.


SEMANALMENTE Participar de uma reunião semanal 1:1 com o CEO. Relatório de realizações e métricas é entregue ao CEO ATÉ 22:00 da noite (Horário de Brasília) em dias úteis. Participar de todas as reuniões conforme solicitado, incluindo, mas não se limitando a sujeito a alterações/. Reuniões Diárias, semanais e mensais.


(Conteúdo do documento/vaga, continuação das responsabilidades):

  • Apresentar relatórios
  • Participar de reuniões semanais 1:1 e check-ins estratégicos com o time.

Requisitos do Cargo

  • Experiência prévia com a área de vendas.
  • Experiência sólida e comprovada com CRM, Excel, Inteligência artificial, Trello, Instagram, Whatsapp Business, Word.
  • Capacidade de seguir processos estruturados e repetir diariamente.
  • Excelente atenção aos detalhes e habilidade de comunicação.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em nutrição e/ou treinamento físico é uma vantagem.
  • Experiência prévia em um ambiente de trabalho remoto é uma vantagem.
  • Habilidade de se relacionar e trabalhar em equipe.
  • Equipamento: O candidato deverá possuir seu próprio computador para execução das atividades.

Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Ser extremamente organizada e detalhista: Manter a rotina e os processos estruturados.
  • Disciplina e Pontualidade: Cumprir prazos e compromissos.
  • Comunicação Escrita: Habilidade de entender "pelas entrelinhas" e se expressar de forma clara.
  • Resiliência: Adapte-se a tarefas monótonas e repetitivas sem perder a motivação.
  • Empatia e Escuta Ativa: Relacionar-se bem com colegas e clientes.
  • Estilo de Vida Saudável: Interesse em praticar atividade física e manter uma alimentação saudável.

Detalhamento das Responsabilidades do Cargo

  • Primeiro contato: Inicie o relacionamento com clientes potenciais através de abordagens abordadas.
  • Pesquisa e Qualificação de Leads: Investiga e identifica oportunidades de negócio, qualificando os leads conforme os critérios estabelecidos.
  • Reativação de Clientes: Buscar e reengajar clientes inativos para retomar oportunidades de vendas.
  • Prospecção e Acompanhamento: Realizar a prospecção ativa e acompanhar continuamente o engajamento dos leads, garantindo que permaneçam específicos.
  • Utilização de Ferramentas: Fazer uso de CRM e ferramentas de planilhas para organizar e monitorar as atividades e os resultados.
  • Etapa no Instagram: Conduzir parte do processo de prospecção e qualificação diretamente pelo Instagram,
  • Monitoramento de Resultados: Acompanhar e reportar os KPIs específicos para garantir o alcance das metas de leads incluídas em períodos definidos (30, 60 e 90 dias).


  • Você precisa ter o seu equipamento, como notebook para que possamos disponibilizar os softwares.

title: Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 5 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You

  • You’re a full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 3+ years of experience.
  • You’re a product-minded engineer with a pragmatic approach to building software.
  • You write expressive readable and maintainable code instead of just hacking together something that only works.
  • You’re curious about IoT, WiFi and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
  • You want to learn how a business operates and get exposure beyond just writing code.


About the Role

  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Javascript and deploy it via Heroku.
  • Work with the CTO to break down large projects into small shippable slices and execute on those projects.
  • Build API integrations with 3rd party software providers
  • Create intelligent scripts and integrations to automate WiFi management tasks
  • Create and review pull requests in Github.


Why Work at StayFi?

  • You’ll be working directly with the CTO and CEO on mission critical projects.
  • You’ll get mentorship directly from the CTO and senior engineers who can help you go from being a junior or mid-level engineer to being a true master.
  • As you continue to do good work and help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to learn the ins and outs of running a sustainable and growing business.
  • You’ll be working on a small team, so you’ll get the chance to have a large impact within our company and in the vacation rental industry at large.

title: Analista de remuneração
description:
Faça parte do time de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo!

Nosso propósito é Tornar o Mundo um Lugar Mais Seguro e não vamos parar até conseguir, pois somos incansáveis e pensamos positivamente.

Nossa paixão? Cuidar de todos, sejam eles clientes, o planeta ou nossos colaboradores pois as pessoas são importantes para nós.

Trabalhamos para que as pessoas vivam tranquilamente, tanto em seu ambiente físico quanto no digital, a fim de gerar um impacto positivo em sua vida pessoal e profissional.

Com mais de 40 anos de história, presente em 26 países e com mais de 160.000 funcionários em todo o mundo. Somos uma das empresas líderes mundiais do setor de Segurança Privada, que oferece Soluções Integradas de Segurança, adaptadas às necessidades de nossos clientes.

Toda nossa história não seria possível sem um time de heróis e por isso desenvolvemos diariamente programas específicos para atrair novos talentos e promovemos a carreira dos nossos profissionais com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades internas de crescimento.

Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer segurança inovadora com base nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado. No Brasil, o Grupo Prosegur conta com três linhas de negócio: Segurpro, Prosegur Cash e Cipher. Viva uma excelente experiência, participando de um processo seletivo 100% digital, pois temos equipes dedicadas para garantir a qualidade, segurança e humanização em todas as etapas!

Diversidade & Inclusão na Prosegur

Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho!

O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. Acreditamos que times diversos podem garantir resultados espetaculares além de impulsionar nossa cultura inovadora

Conheça esta oportunidade de trabalho na Segurpro/ Cash e se você possui os requisitos para a vaga, FAÇA JÁ A SUA INSCRIÇÃO.

* Vaga aberta a pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Se você é PCD e possui os requisitos e interesse , junte-se à nossa equipe de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo e venha ser Protagonista de uma história de sucesso!

  • Realização de análises salariais internas e de mercado.
  • Apoio em movimentações salariais, promoções e revisões.
  • Elaboração de relatórios e dashboards com dados de remuneração e headcount.
  • Participação em ciclos de remuneração anual (bônus, méritos, revisão salarial).
  • Condução de processos de descrição e avaliação de cargos.
  • Suporte técnico a gestores e parceiros de RH.
  • Estudo de impacto orçamentário e aplicação de convenções coletivas (CCT).
  • Atualização de organogramas e estruturas funcionais.
  • Governança dos sistemas organizacionais e bases de dados.
  • Desenvolvimento de dashboards.
  • Apoio em projetos de redesenho organizacional.

  • Atuação anterior com estrutura organizacional e cargos.
  • Atuação anterior em remuneração, cargos e salários.
  • Excel e Power-BI avançado.

title: Software Development Manager
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled and proactive Software Development Manager to lead our engineering team. In this role, you will oversee daily operations, provide strategic leadership, and drive initiatives to enhance service delivery and customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate combines technical expertise with strong people management.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Management role within Encora Brazil Division Global Solutions Team;
  • Technical leadership: Lead complex and multi-disciplinary projects, help the team with problem solving by offering suggestions, technical guidelines and feedback, ensure quality, performance and security. Deliver results and challenge the team, actively working in technical discussions, architecture and other decisions, focused on Development routines;
  • Project Management: ensure valuable deliveries, timeline, ceremonies, project metrics, remove blocks, manage risks, report project status, collect and apply lessons learned, propose changes to the existing SW Development process to achieve better results;
  • People Management: evaluations, IDP, feedback, 1:1, ensure processes are followed, improve productivity, technical and soft skills, motivate the team, provide career direction, hiring and dismissal process, ability to retain talents;
  • Relationship management with multiple stakeholders (both technical and business), taking accountability to deliver software solutions and getting development team’s commitment;
  • Suggest and promote process improvements.



Essential Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or other related areas or equivalent work experience;
  • Experience with Software Development;
  • Experience in a leadership role in software development projects;
  • Experience in delivering software projects, management, building and staffing of software development teams;
  • Manage customer expectations while working with cross-functional teams to meet customer/product delivery goals;
  • Knowledge and experience in agile methodologies;
  • Drive team to innovate and deliver roadmap features with agility and high quality;
  • Hands on profile, actively involved in technical and architectural discussions.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior Python Software Engineer (AI)
description:
About Pyyne

Pyyne is a modern technology consultancy engineering the next generation of digital products and services.


At Pyyne, we believe in using technology to unlock business potential, create sustainable growth, and drive forward digital excellence. Our solutions range from advanced Software Engineering, Cloud, and Data & AI solutions.


Job Summary

Pyyne is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, skilled in Python and with experience developing solutions with LLMs to work as a Consultant out of our Brazilian Office. This is a high-impact role for Pyyne as we scale up our AI Services and onboard new and exciting clients in this sector. 


A successful candidate in this role will be self-motivated and responsible for the full product lifecycle, from architecting scalable systems to rapid prototyping and experimentation. If you are passionate about building robust, high-quality systems and want to make a significant impact on an innovative product, this role is for you. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect & Build : Design, develop, and deploy scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP that serve as the backbone for our AI-powered products.
  • Develop AI Solutions: Implement and optimize sophisticated AI systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI agents, to solve complex client problems.
  • Innovate & Experiment: Rapidly prototype and experiment with cutting-edge LLM-based solutions, including prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and tool integration.
  • Champion Code Quality: Take ownership of the development lifecycle and champion best practices for writing clean, well-tested, and maintainable code.
  • Collaborate & Lead: Work closely with product, data, and business stakeholders to shape the AI product roadmap and provide technical leadership.


Must Have Skills: 

  • Expert-Level Python: 3+ years of professional experience with deep, demonstrated expertise in Python and its ecosystem for building robust APIs and data-driven applications.
  • Production Cloud Experience: A proven track record of designing, building, and deploying scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP. You are comfortable with core services like Lambda/Cloud Functions, S3/Cloud Storage, EC2/Compute Engine, etc.
  • Hands-On AI Experience: You have built and shipped at least one AI-powered feature or application, demonstrating your ability to translate AI concepts into real-world solutions.
  • Engineering Excellence: You are a self-starter who takes ownership, writes
  • high-quality, maintainable code, and has a keen eye for detail.


Nice to Have Skills: 

  • Applied AI Development: Hands-on experience developing solutions with LLMs (e.g. via OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere APIs) and/or agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google ADK).
  • AI Infrastructure: Familiarity with services like AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI.
  • Vector Databases: Knowledge of vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) and semantic search concepts.
  • Modern DevOps: Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).


Benefits:

  • Salary Range from 3,443 - 4,120 USD/mo  
  • Flexible remote working environment.
  • Career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack (Node.js + React Native)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

— Atuar em um assessment técnico com foco em análise profunda da base atual das aplicações Web e Mobile.

— Revisar código das aplicações desenvolvidas em Node.js e React Native , avaliando qualidade, padrões utilizados e aderência às boas práticas.

— Identificar bugs, riscos, dívidas técnicas e oportunidades de melhoria técnica e arquitetural.

— Mapear integrações, APIs, serviços e dependências do sistema, garantindo entendimento completo da estrutura atual.

— Documentar os achados, pontos críticos e recomendações, apoiando o time técnico na definição dos próximos passos.

— Contribuir com insights técnicos para melhoria contínua do código e estabilidade da aplicação.


O que você precisa ter

— Forte experiência prática com Node.js e React Native (Web e Mobile).

— Vivência consistente com revisão de código (code review) e análise estrutural de aplicações.

— Conhecimento sólido de boas práticas , padrões de desenvolvimento e qualidade de código.

— Capacidade analítica para identificar problemas em bases legadas, arquiteturas pouco padronizadas e integrações complexas.

— Experiência com APIs, integrações e entendimento de dependências técnicas.

— Boa comunicação para documentar achados e conduzir discussões técnicas.


Desejável

— Experiência com arquitetura limpa, padrões de projeto ou refatoração estruturada.

— Vivência em ambientes com múltiplas integrações (REST, microserviços, filas, etc.).

— Conhecimento em TypeScript.

— Experiência prévia com auditoria de código, due diligence técnica ou assessment de sistemas.


Perfil esperado

— Olhar crítico e foco em melhoria contínua.

— Mentalidade estruturada, organizada e detalhista.

— Proatividade para propor soluções e identificar riscos técnicos.

— Autonomia e capacidade de analisar ambientes complexos.

— Curiosidade técnica e vontade de elevar o nível da base existente.


Onde você vai trabalhar

Remoto.

title: Head Comercial
description:
Sobre o Ibiti Projeto

Fundado em 1982, o Ibiti Projeto surgiu com o objetivo de promover a regeneração ambiental na região. Hoje, cobre uma área com mais de 6.000 hectares onde, além da restauração natural, desenvolve projetos de rewilding com a reintegração da fauna nativa, parcerias com iniciativas ambientais, produção orgânica de alimentos e apoio ao desenvolvimento da comunidade local. Estamos nas montanhas de Minas Gerais.

Dentro do território, contamos com três conceitos de hospedagem:

Ibiti Village: uma típica vila do interior, com 11 acomodações para receber nossos visitantes.

Engenho Lodge: uma grande casa com 8 suítes, e a Casa Carlinhos , uma residência típica de fazenda com 3 suítes.

Remote: três casas localizadas em áreas isoladas do Projeto, que proporcionam maior conexão com a natureza.

O Ibiti é referência internacional em luxury hospitality com impacto positivo, e orgulha-se de importantes reconhecimentos:

  • Primeiro hotel B Corp do Brasil – Certificado pela B Lab Global desde 2017
  • Condé Nast Johansens Excellence Award 2024 – Melhor prática de sustentabilidade na América do Sul e Central
  • Forbes Lifestyle 2023 – Entre os destinos mais promissores em hospitalidade
  • Robb Report 2023 – Top 50 melhores hotéis de luxo do mundo


Missão do Cargo

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Quality Engineer with 5+ years of experience, including 2+ years of experience with test automation systems. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with product and development teams to drive quality throughout the entire software lifecycle. This role involves defining test strategies and plans, developing and executing test cases, and building automation scripts to ensure high-quality software delivery. The Senior QA Engineer will also analyze system performance and contribute to ongoing automation efforts to enhance testing efficiency and reliability.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements fully and ensure that test plans, methods, and strategies will cause delivered software to meet or exceed expectations
  • Drive the successful validation of large-scale systems, creating test plans, cases, and strategies, as well as driving quality assurance processes
  • Develop intelligent and efficient testing strategies to dramatically increase the ratio of internally found defects versus customer-reported defects
  • Design, develop, and maintain automation tests using the chosen frameworks
  • Plan and perform functional, E2E, and regression testing, keeping pace with the Agile team, and reporting and finding issues
  • Provide test summary reports that communicate key quality indicators, risks, and mitigations to leadership
  • Accurately estimate testing requirements for input into planning efforts
  • Enhance the test case library to increase test case coverage
  • Strive to ensure quality releases of software with no production downs and/or critical impediments to users
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior QA engineers


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and collaboration skills
  • 5+ years of quality assurance engineering experience working with web applications and/or SaaS applications in an Agile / Scrum environment with a strong focus on automation
  • 2+ years of experience working with Cypress or Playwright to automate UI and API tests using TypeScript and/or Java
  • Experience building and maintaining not only the tests themselves but also the infrastructure that enables the tests
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Fluent in SQL and relational databases, including experience testing relational database-backed applications
  • Familiar with CI/CD (Github Actions preferred)
  • Experience with performance testing and pressure testing
  • Motivation to achieve - must be self-directed with a high degree of initiative
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or equivalent education (a technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Programming Languages: JavaScript and Python
  • Others: Webdriver, Cucumber, Karate, Postman, Amazon S3, Mailtrap, Sentry, and Testrail


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members on client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Tech Lead | Data Engineer
description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro

A Getnet é uma empresa global de tecnologia especializada em soluções de pagamento para o comércio. Fundada no Brasil e presente na América Latina e na Península Ibérica, apoiamos mais de 1,3 milhão de comerciantes com serviços completos — da maquininha ao e-commerce.

Fazemos parte da PagoNxt , a fintech global do Grupo Santander, e atuamos como um hub de adquirência com forte presença em Espanha, Portugal, Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai .

Nossa missão é clara: simplificar os pagamentos com inovação, segurança e escala , ajudando negócios de todos os tamanhos a crescer com agilidade.

Oferecemos uma plataforma unificada que integra hardware, software, prevenção à fraude, adquirência, conciliação e serviços financeiros — tudo em um só ecossistema, para que nossos clientes possam focar no crescimento do seu negócio.

Fazer parte da Getnet é se juntar a uma empresa que combina a inovação de uma fintech com a solidez de um banco global.

Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.

Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza.

Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.

✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?


Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Tech Lead - Data Engineering para se juntar ao nosso time em Data Plataform.


O que você vai fazer

Como Tech Lead de Data Engineering, você será a referência técnica em nossa infraestrutura de Data Platform, liderando iniciativas relacionadas à gestão de dados de interação com nossos clientes, incluindo a elaboração de demonstrativos de vendas e extratos. Terá papel fundamental na Transformação Tecnológica, apoiando a transição de sistemas legados (Oracle, PL SQL, OpenShift) para tecnologias modernas (Spark/Scala, SQL, Databricks, Atlas, Kubernetes), garantindo a continuidade dos negócios e a minimização de riscos.


  • Você será referência Técnica: Atuando como especialista técnico, orientando o time de engenharia em boas práticas, arquitetura e decisões estratégicas de tecnologia.
  • Colaboração com Stakeholders: Trabalhar próximo a times de produto, tecnologia e negócio para entender necessidades e traduzir em soluções eficazes.
  • Evolução Tecnológica: Apoiar a modernização de sistemas e migração para ambientes em nuvem, garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e desempenho.
  • Integração de Sistemas: Projetar e apoiar integrações de novos sistemas com a infraestrutura existente, assegurando eficiência operacional.
  • Cultura de Inovação: Promover boas práticas de engenharia, cultura de colaboração e aprendizado contínuo no time.
  • Conciliação de Informações: Apoiar a construção de soluções para conciliações de pequenos, médios e grandes comércios, além de fluxos regulatórios (bandeiras, BACEN, etc.).


✅ O que buscamos em você

  • Experiência em Arquitetura de Software: Sólido conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura, engenharia de software e data engineering.
  • Gestão de Riscos Técnicos: Capacidade de identificar riscos em soluções e propor alternativas.
  • Vivência técnica com: ORACLE, PL SQL, SQL, JAVA, DATABRICKS, SPARK/SCALA;
  • Kubernetes e Cloud (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud);
  • APIs e Integrações: atuação em Integração de Sistemas: Capacidade de projetar e validar soluções interoperáveis em ambientes complexos.


✅ O que pode contar pontos a mais

  • Experiência em empresas de adquirência ou tecnologia.
  • Familiaridade com fluxo de extrato financeiro.
  • Atuação anterior como Tech Lead ou Especialista Técnico em projetos de modernização de plataformas de dados.


O que oferecemos

title: Web Developer
description:
React Web Developer with strong Strapi expertise | Brazil - remote | Contractor


Job Overview

Our client is seeking a highly skilled React Web Developer with strong Strapi expertise to lead the development, optimization, and continuous improvement of our website and Headless CMS ecosystem. You will be responsible for rebuilding and enhancing the digital front-end experience using React and Strapi v5 , ensuring top-tier performance, stability, and scalability.

This role requires a proactive professional capable of taking ownership from day one—someone who can solve complex problems, implement robust solutions, and drive ongoing improvements across the platform. This is not an entry-level position.


Responsibilities

  • Architect and develop fast, scalable, and reliable front-end solutions using React and Strapi .
  • Rebuild, refine, and optimize existing website sections to maximize performance and conversion.
  • Maintain Core Web Vitals in the green, using real-user monitoring and observability tools.
  • Design, implement, and manage content structures, schemas, and data models in Strapi v5.
  • Integrate CMS features with analytics and marketing tools such as Vercel, Microsoft Clarity, HubSpot APIs, and Google Analytics.
  • Automate deployment workflows and repetitive development tasks to improve efficiency.
  • Collaborate closely with design, content, and product teams to ensure seamless execution.
  • Ensure accurate tracking, strong server response performance, and a high-quality user experience across all devices.
  • Evaluate and responsibly incorporate AI-assisted development tools that enhance productivity without compromising code quality.


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building front-end applications with React .
  • Advanced experience working with Headless CMS platforms , particularly Strapi (v4+; v5 preferred).
  • Proficiency with Vercel , GitHub, continuous deployment, and server-side integrations.
  • Solid understanding of API configuration and consumption within Headless CMS environments.
  • Ability to troubleshoot, debug, and deploy fixes in real-time production environments.
  • Demonstrated experience improving conversion rates and running A/B testing experiments.
  • Strong knowledge of analytics tools and CMS integrations.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.


Bonus Skills

  • Experience integrating and customizing HubSpot APIs .
  • Familiarity with SEO , CRO , and performance-driven digital strategies.
  • Previous experience working in high-growth or startup environments.
  • Exposure to AI-driven development workflows , frameworks, or tools.


If converted to full-time, you will be eligible for:

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective the 1st of the month following full-time hire)
  • Paid holidays annually
  • Paid vacation and sick leave
  • Flexible working hours

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Remote, U.S. Oil & Gas Operations Project Manager (Bilingual)


Are you a seasoned PMO/Business Analyst with at least 8 years of experience looking for a challenging, high-impact remote role supporting major U.S. energy operations?

We are seeking a highly skilled, mid-level professional to function as a crucial PMO Analyst and Business Analyst hybrid, enabling organizational change management, process optimization, and project coordination. This role offers the unique opportunity to lead tactical improvements and shape organizational efficiency from an offshore location, working closely with U.S. leadership.

English Skills a Must (C1 or C2 only)


The PetroHire Advantage


We offer best-in-class support for our remote team members to ensure you can perform at your peak:

  • 100% Remote: Work from the comfort of your home base.
  • Top-Tier Equipment Provided: We provide a new laptop and essential peripherals.
  • Guaranteed Connectivity: We provide paid redundant internet and battery backup.


Key Responsibilities


The core focus of this role is tactical execution, process improvement, and organizational enablement.


Project Coordination & Change Management

  • Coordinate and track multiple, simultaneous project work streams, ensuring strict adherence to timelines and high-quality deliverables.
  • Lead and facilitate complex group workshops independently, engaging effectively with both field operations and senior office personnel.
  • Mediate and facilitate discussions to proactively resolve conflicts and manage stakeholder expectations across work streams.
  • Develop critical change management documentation, including RACI charts , Management of Change (MOC) documents, and Workstream Charters .


Business Process Mapping & Optimization

  • Perform hands-on process mapping and workflow development using modern methodologies (e.g., Lean Six Sigma and Agile principles).
  • Collaborate with domain experts and field personnel to accurately capture complex current-state business processes.
  • Develop optimized process maps and workflows that specifically support automation and organizational efficiency goals.


Data Analysis, Documentation & Reporting

  • Perform intermediate-level data analysis and build compelling dashboards/visualizations using Power BI and Advanced Excel .
  • Create leadership-level communication materials (e.g., polished PowerPoint presentations) and work intake management documentation.
  • Support data integration and reporting from unified data environments (e.g., Snowflake).


Required Skills & Experience


  • Experience: At least 8 years post-graduation experience, ideally in a PMO, Business Analyst, or Process Improvement role.
  • Language: Must be fluent in English (C1/C2 level) to communicate effectively with U.S. leadership and teams.
  • Proficiency in project and visualization tools (MS Project, Visio, Mural, Excel, and BI platforms).
  • Strong expertise in Business Process Mapping (BPM) is mandatory.
  • Intermediate data analytics skills; familiarity with SQL or workflow automation (Power Automate) is a plus.
  • Advanced presentation, conflict management, and group facilitation skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently and lead sessions without close supervision.
  • Demonstrated intercultural competence and experience working effectively with U.S.-based teams.


Preferred Qualifications (A Strong Plus)


  • Experience within the Upstream Oil & Gas industry environment.
  • Relevant professional certifications such as PMP, CBAP, or Lean Six Sigma .
  • A mindset that embraces the 'Own It' culture : high commitment, critical thinking, and exceptional organizational skills.

title: Sr. Cisco Meraki Security
description:
Sr. Cisco Meraki MX Security SME

Duration: Phase One is around 4 months , with high potential for extension into Phases Two and Three

Location: Remote from Brazil (must)

Work Hours: Standard business hours CST with flexibility for deployment windows

Expected Start Date: November 2025


Job Overview:

This role is critical to the successful execution of client’s phased deployment of Cisco Meraki MX devices and associated security technologies across multiple customer locations. Lead the technical implementation of Phase One, which includes seven sites, and will directly contribute to the customer’s digital transformation and security posture. This is a cross-functional role requiring collaboration with IT, security, and cloud teams to ensure seamless integration and operational readiness.


Job Description:

  • Conduct discovery and documentation of existing IP schema across seven customer locations.
  • Design and implement new IP subnets for Office, Wireless, and Management networks.
  • Review DHCP server configuration, scope, and scope options for each location.
  • Identify network hosts that require manual static IP modifications or changes.
  • Deploy and configure Cisco Meraki MX devices, including switch port VLAN mapping.
  • Create standardized operational templates, profiles, and dashboards for Meraki environments.
  • Establish secure VPN tunnels and configure Cisco Secure Client for endpoint protection.
  • Cisco Secure Client Integration: Ensure the use of Cisco Secure Client for secure access.
  • Endpoint and End User Connections: Create and manage connections with endpoints and end users.
  • VPN Access: Ensure VPN access is available across all devices.
  • Cloud Integration: Integrate with Azure and AWS for cloud services.
  • Integrate Cisco Duo MFA to secure access to critical applications (e.g., Pension Pro).
  • Perform Active Directory integration for centralized user management.
  • Support cloud service integration with Azure and AWS.
  • Collaborate with internal and customer teams to ensure successful deployment and knowledge transfer.
  • Participate in testing, validation, and final review phases of the project.


Must Haves:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in enterprise network deployment and configuration .
  • Proven experience with Cisco Meraki MX series, including dashboard configuration and VPN setup.
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco Duo MFA and Cisco Secure Client .
  • Familiarity with IP schema design, subnetting, and VLAN configuration.
  • Experience integrating cloud services (Azure, AWS) into enterprise networks.
  • Prior involvement in phased deployment projects across multiple physical locations is preferred.
  • Security
  • Meraki MX Series
  • IP Schema Design
  • Cisco Duo MFA and Cisco Secure Client


Educational Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Cisco certifications (e.g., CCNA, Meraki CMNA) preferred.
  • Additional certifications in cloud platforms (Azure/AWS) or security (e.g., CISSP) are a plus.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Quality Engineer with 5+ years of experience, including 2+ years of experience with test automation systems. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with product and development teams to drive quality throughout the entire software lifecycle. This role involves defining test strategies and plans, developing and executing test cases, and building automation scripts to ensure high-quality software delivery. The Senior QA Engineer will also analyze system performance and contribute to ongoing automation efforts to enhance testing efficiency and reliability.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements fully and ensure that test plans, methods, and strategies will cause delivered software to meet or exceed expectations
  • Drive the successful validation of large-scale systems, creating test plans, cases, and strategies, as well as driving quality assurance processes
  • Develop intelligent and efficient testing strategies to dramatically increase the ratio of internally found defects versus customer-reported defects
  • Design, develop, and maintain automation tests using the chosen frameworks
  • Plan and perform functional, E2E, and regression testing, keeping pace with the Agile team, and reporting and finding issues
  • Provide test summary reports that communicate key quality indicators, risks, and mitigations to leadership
  • Accurately estimate testing requirements for input into planning efforts
  • Enhance the test case library to increase test case coverage
  • Strive to ensure quality releases of software with no production downs and/or critical impediments to users
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior QA engineers


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and collaboration skills
  • 5+ years of quality assurance engineering experience working with web applications and/or SaaS applications in an Agile / Scrum environment with a strong focus on automation
  • 2+ years of experience working with Cypress or Playwright to automate UI and API tests using TypeScript and/or Java
  • Experience building and maintaining not only the tests themselves but also the infrastructure that enables the tests
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Fluent in SQL and relational databases, including experience testing relational database-backed applications
  • Familiar with CI/CD (Github Actions preferred)
  • Experience with performance testing and pressure testing
  • Motivation to achieve - must be self-directed with a high degree of initiative
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or equivalent education (a technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Programming Languages: JavaScript and Python
  • Others: Webdriver, Cucumber, Karate, Postman, Amazon S3, Mailtrap, Sentry, and Testrail


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members on client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Engineer to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you.


Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the correct L2 teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in technical customer support.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Must have technical and analytical ability to diagnose problems.
  • Basic understanding of frameworks such as Agile, ITIL, COBIT.
  • Proficient with ticketing tools ( Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce).
  • Solid understanding of web page construction (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
  • Know how to execute standard debugging for website issues.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us
